SYSTEM-LEVEL UML USE-CASE DIAGRAM • Patient and Admin goals
Select doctor, date and available time
«include» = required reusable behavior; the dashed arrow points to the included use case.
«extend» = optional/conditional behavior; the dashed arrow points to the base use case.
Hollow triangle = generalization; the specific use case points to its broader parent.
UC-5 outcome mentions admin appointment management, but its title / FR-5 specify doctor and schedule maintenance.
This diagram does not assume admins can edit or cancel patient bookings. Add a separate FR/use case if required.
Protected actions require an authenticated, role-authorized account; frozen/banned patient accounts are restricted.
Traceability: UC-1→FR-1 • UC-2→FR-2 • UC-3→FR-3 • UC-4→FR-4 • UC-5→FR-5 • UC-6→FR-6 • UC-7→FR-7 • UC-8→FR-8
